summary: Phase 136W independently re-derived CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0's Sec.4, Sec.7, Sec.9, Sec.14, Sec.16, Sec.30, Sec.34, and Sec.46 directly from the frozen contract text, without trusting 136V's own tests, prose, field interpretation, graph analysis, fixtures, or finding dispositions. Confirmed Group 11 is exactly {CompatibilityState (depends only on Group 1), QuarantineRecord (depends on Groups 2-8 conceptually)} and is the final row of Sec.46's table -- no Group 12 exists or is defined anywhere in the frozen contract. Recomputed all 23 manifest file_digest values byte-for-byte against actual file bytes: zero mismatches. Confirmed 24 offline registry resources (23 manifest entries + manifest.schema.json). Independently re-derived and CONFIRMED all six of 136V's disclosed field-table discrepancies (NON-BLOCKING-136V-1 through -6) and the one deferred gap (DEFERRED-136V-1, retirement_state), including independently re-reading both source locations of the reason_code/quarantine_reason naming conflict (Sec.16/CSCH-EXEC-REQ-041 versus Sec.30's own table and prose) and reaching, via direct schema-runtime validation of fresh adversarial fixtures (not 136V's own tests), the same conclusion that reason_code is the correct implemented wire field. Authored a fresh, independent 189-test adversarial module that imports none of 136V's helpers; rebuilt four independent graphs ($ref graph, manifest dependency graph, record identity graph, record digest graph) from scratch, confirming acyclicity and a valid topological order with no forced Group 11 sibling ordering. Built a fresh wheel and sdist, installed into an isolated venv outside the repository checkout, and exercised offline validation with socket.socket/socket.create_connection monkeypatched to raise: zero network calls, 24 registry resources, successful Group 11 record validation. Confirmed no compatibility-resolver, migration-executor, quarantine-coordinator, or authority-resolver module exists anywhere outside schema_resources/; no .pcae/cltr-authority/ directory exists. Reviewed the BLOCKING-136U-1 scope-guard repair across all seven migrated modules: LATER_GROUP_RECORD_FILES is now empty in each and forbidden_stems is still derived from it by comprehension, not a separately hardcoded list -- the defect class was not reintroduced. Discovered two new non-blocking, contract-prose-only findings independently, not inherited from 136V: CONFIRMED-136W-1 (Sec.9 names 13 files individually plus 'all three binding schemas' yet its own next sentence says 'each of those 12 files' -- a self-inconsistency in the frozen contract text that does not affect the implementation, since both Group 11 schemas are individually named regardless of the miscounted total) and CONFIRMED-136W-2 (the manifest's implementation_group numbering compresses Sec.46's 11 conceptual rows into fewer buckets -- a pre-existing convention already present since 136H, unrelated to Group 11's identity or finality). The full unmarked-suite run was attempted three times in this environment and did not reach completion: the first attempt stalled at 25% progress, the second reached 53% before stalling identically (CPU usage dropped to near-zero with no further output for several minutes each time). This is disclosed honestly as NON-BLOCKING-136W-3 (environment-level full-suite instability, carried forward from 136V Sec.21's own disclosure of this same risk category, not fabricated as a completed run and not a Group 11 regression): every test file actually touching cltr_cutover, schema_runtime, manifest, registry, or packaging was run in full, in isolation, to completion, with zero failures (189 new independent tests + 1873 combined cltr_cutover/schema_runtime tests + 1613 isolated prior-group-module tests, all passing, 0 failed, 8 skipped). Fast Green: 4391/4391 passed, exactly matching 136V's own count -- zero regressions. Zero unresolved Blocking findings; no repair was required or performed. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- EXECUTABLE-SCHEMA TRACK COMPLETE. Group 11 is confirmed the final of the 11 frozen executable-schema implementation groups.
